review_candidates.title: Senior Robotics Specialist
review_candidates.description: Summary This role is responsible for defining and driving the site robotics strategy, portfolio, and roadmap, leading the evaluation, deployment, and scaling of robotics solutions across manufacturing, laboratories, warehouses, and support operations. The position manages multiple initiatives simultaneously, aligns site priorities with enterprise robotics goals and standards, and influences technology, investment, and deployment decisions through cross-functional collaboration. Working without direct reports, the role coordinates internal experts and external partners to deliver standardized, compliant, scalable, and sustainable robotics solutions that generate measurable business value. About The Role Major Accountabilities Own the robotics strategy and roadmap. Maintain a prioritized site roadmap aligned with business needs, enterprise standards, technology maturity, and market developments. Build the use-case pipeline. Identify, assess, and prioritize robotics opportunities across manufacturing, laboratories, warehouses, and support functions. Lead delivery and scaling. Drive robotics initiatives from concept, feasibility study, and pilot through validated deployment, operational handover, lifecycle support, and reuse across sites. Coordinate Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Operational Excellence, Procurement, Digital, vendors, and system integrators Define requirements and standards. Own and harmonize User Requirement Specifications, reference architectures, technical standards, deployment frameworks, and the robotics catalog. Evaluate technology and vendors. Assess robotics, AMR/AGV, cobots, machine vision, automated inspection, autonomous systems, and physical AI for technical fit, compliance, scalability, maintainability, cost, and business value. Act as robotics subject matter expert. Advise ITOT and site leadership on solution architecture, integration, technology selection, implementation risks, and investment priorities. Ensure compliance and governance. Align solutions with GxP, validation, data integrity, quality, safety, OT cybersecurity, and applicable regulatory requirements. Build business cases and track value. Quantify benefits, support investment decisions, manage the project portfolio and budget, and report delivery, adoption, risks, and realized value. Promote approved platforms, reusable solutions, lessons learned, and consistent ways of working across locations. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. At least 7 years of experience in industrial robotics, automation, manufacturing engineering, advanced manufacturing technology, or IT/OT. Proven delivery of robotics or advanced automation solutions from concept through production deployment. Experience defining URSs, technical standards, solution architectures, and vendor evaluation criteria. Strong knowledge of robotics hardware, industrial controls, system integration, machine vision, autonomous systems, and automation architectures. Experience in regulated manufacturing, including GxP, validation, data integrity, quality, safety, and OT cybersecurity requirements. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators in a global environment. Experience developing business cases and managing project portfolios, budgets, risks, and benefits. Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, cell and gene therapy, or other life sciences manufacturing experience. Hands-on experience with AMRs, AGVs, cobots, robotic material handling, machine vision, automated inspection, laboratory automation, or AI-enabled robotics. Familiarity with Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, digital manufacturing, and autonomous manufacturing concepts. Experience scaling standardized solutions across multiple sites or platforms, Business fluency in English. Benefits and Rewards: Competitive salary, Annual bonus, Flexible working schedule, tailored to your needs, possibility to work from home, Pension scheme, possibility of joining collective health insurance scheme, Employee Recognition Scheme, Expanded program for the promotion of health in the field of physical and mental well-being and managing workload (Well-being), Unlimited learning and development opportunities. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve. Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture Benefits and Rewards: Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally. Working within complex system-of-systems environments, you will ensure solutions are safe, resilient, interoperable and aligned with Hybrid Navy strategic objectives . Collaborating with customers, suppliers and engineering teams across BAE Systems and the broader defence enterprise, you will influence strategic direction and deliver future-ready platform integration solutions that support operational performance and long-term capability growth. Core duties: Lead platform interface architecture and integration strategy. Define standards, interfaces and system integration principles . Support digital ship technologies, automation and control systems. Influence stakeholders on platform integration strategy and delivery. Essential skills: A degree in Engineering (or a related subject) Full membership of an appropriate engineering institution and be a Chartered Engineer (or actively working towards). Combat System Engineering Team: Within the dynamic and rapidly expanding Naval Ships Combat Systems business, you will form part of a highly skilled team of system architects charged with shaping the future of maritime mission systems. Working across domestic and international programmes alongside enterprise partners, in bringing to bear your specialist expertise , you will ensure that candidate solutions are innovative, future-force-ready, operationally relevant and coherent with customer and business needs. Why BAE Systems? Here youll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. review_candidates.description: Location: Netherlands (Specific location is not fixed, anyone based within the Benelux region can be considered) Salary: £86K + £68K OTE Reporting into: European Sales Manager About us Every refrigerated truck and trailer moving goods across the country has relied on diesel for decades. It's polluting, expensive, and the technology has not changed. Two companies have dominated the market, selling the same legacy technology with minor updates. Sunswap makes the electric refrigeration that's replacing it — zero emissions, lower operating costs, built from the ground up for how fleets actually operate. Endurance runs frozen goods for 24 hours on a single charge and chilled goods for up to two months. Those numbers matter on the road, and getting them right took years of obsessive engineering from a team drawn from automotive, aerospace, and motorsport. We have gone from founding to manufacturing at scale globally in just six years. We built our own production facility in Surrey. Today we are 200 times larger by square footage than when we started. We operate on three continents — units run across the UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Chile, and Australia. And we are trusted by major brands like Tesco, Ocado, Birds Eye, and Happy Eggs every single day. We have been named Sunday Times Best Place to Work in 2024, 2025 and 2026. We have won awards for innovation, technology, and marketing excellence. We have backing from leading investors including BGF, Barclays, Clean Growth Fund, Shell, and Rabobank. We have got the customers, the traction, and the momentum. Now we are taking this British-engineered product global — scaling manufacturing, opening new markets, and building the team that will make legacy polluting technology obsolete across the world. If you want to be part of a company that is setting new standards for the industry and scaling internationally, this is it. Our benefits 30 days of annual leave (includes a Wellbeing Day) Sabbatical (after 3 years of working with Sunswap) 5 free counselling sessions per year Family leave ranging from 4 weeks to 4 months Cycle to Work Scheme Pension Job overview The Senior Account Executive (Benelux) will spearhead Sunswap's strategic launch in Benelux and the broader EU, reporting into Sunswap's European Sales Manager. You will be responsible for setting up commercial and operational functions for the territory to ensure commercial success. Focusing on customer acquisition and building out the aftermarket support network. This is an excellent opportunity to be part of building an early-stage business that is taking on a global duopoly. Key responsibilities Developing and implementing strategic plans for the country, aligning with the company's overall goals. Map out the customer and maintenance service partner landscape. Manage the end-to-end sales cycle (virtually and in person): lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, submitting proposals/tenders, and closing deals via different sales and marketing channels. Maintain a healthy customer and partner pipeline, take ownership of your target sectors and regularly report progress to the broader business. Achieve OKRs, maintain the CRM and follow Sunswap’s processes. In collaboration with the EU Aftermarket Manager, identify, validate and contract with maintenance service partners. Create and present detailed proposals to secure trial agreements, orders and partnership agreements. Lead multi-million pound negotiations for contracts, agreements, and partnerships, ensuring favourable terms and conditions while mitigating risks. Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing partners, understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions to meet their requirements. This involves hosting & attending industry events. Collaborate with our marketing team and agency to generate inbound leads, develop sales materials and foster relationships. Recruit, develop and manage a team to meet the company’s objectives. Keep abreast of the competition and sector developments through regular market analysis. Qualifications & experience Fluent in Dutch and English, with strong communication skills in both languages. Over 7 years of enterprise sales experience, consistently exceeding performance expectations. More than 3 years as a Country/Regional Manager, successfully representing and expanding a business in foreign markets. Proven leadership in team management, driving results through collaboration and strategic direction. Successfully launched new products into new markets, ensuring growth and strong market presence from the ground up. Proven track record in consistently meeting or surpassing revenue targets and achieving ambitious business development goals. Highly proficient in CRM software, the Microsoft Office Suite, and other key business tools for streamlined operations. Flexible and open to travelling throughout Europe to drive business growth and maintain client relationships. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and influence decision-makers at all levels. Strong background in maintaining accurate sales records, including contracts, amendments, addendums, and related correspondence, ensuring clear and compliant documentation throughout the sales process. Advantageous: French, Flemish, German, Spanish or another European language speaker.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Professional Forwarding Services S.A.R.L. is a full-service freight forwarder and customs broker dedicated to delivering reliable, high-quality transportation and logistics solutions. The company provides comprehensive air and ocean freight services, customs brokerage, and end-to-end logistics support for global supply chains. With a strong commitment to quality assurance, Professional Forwarding Services consistently aims to exceed customer expectations. A team of experienced professionals focuses on responsive service, operational efficiency, and tailored solutions that meet diverse client needs. Role Description The Import Coordinator is a full-time, on-site role based in Beirut Governorate, Lebanon. This position is responsible for coordinating and monitoring import shipments from origin to destination, ensuring compliance with customs regulations and internal procedures. Daily tasks include preparing and reviewing import documentation, liaising with customers, carriers, and customs authorities, and tracking shipments to secure timely delivery. The Import Coordinator will handle ocean and air import operations as needed, resolve issues or delays, and maintain accurate records in company systems. The role also involves providing clear communication to clients regarding shipment status, handling service inquiries, and supporting continuous improvement in import processes. Qualifications Minimum 4 years of experience in import coordination. Strong knowledge of import operations, including familiarity with Import regulations and procedures. Experience in Customs Brokerage with the ability to prepare, review, and submit compliance documentation. Understanding of Ocean freight processes and related documentation in international logistics. Excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with clients, carriers, and authorities. Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously. Proficiency in MS Office and logistics or freight management systems. Previous experience in freight forwarding, logistics, or customs brokerage is highly beneficial. Relevant diploma or degree in logistics, supply chain, business, or a related field preferred. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
